_readme: PERSONAL EASTER EGGS for Terrorific. Edit this file to add, change or remove moments; no code changes needed. Reload the page to see edits. Add ?eggs=1 to the game URL to preview EVERY egg (including disabled ones) on every trigger, ignoring chance / once. Set the top-level "enabled" to false to switch the whole system off.

_schema.eggs[].id: string. Unique. Used to remember that a player has already seen it (localStorage key terrorific_eggs_seen_v1).
_schema.eggs[].enabled: bool. false = skipped (unless ?eggs=1 preview). Default true.
_schema.eggs[].once: bool. true (default) = shown only the first time ever on this device; false = may repeat (still at most once per night).
_schema.eggs[].chance: 0..1. Odds when the trigger matches. Omit for always.
_schema.eggs[].delayMs: ms to wait after the trigger before showing. Default 600 (0 for atSec).
_schema.eggs[].trigger.event: one of: nightStart | nightEnd | atSec | scare | grabWin | grabLose | gameOver | win
_schema.eggs[].trigger.night: a night number or a list, e.g. 2 or [2,3,5]. Omit for any night.
_schema.eggs[].trigger.sec: for event atSec: seconds into the night (game time) when it fires.
_schema.eggs[].trigger.kind: for event scare: peek | lightsout | attack | feed. Omit for any.
_schema.eggs[].trigger.minDeaths: for gameOver or any event: only after at least this many deaths this session.
_schema.eggs[].effect.type: text (a line of text over the scene). More types can be added in js/eggs.js show().
_schema.eggs[].effect.text: the words to show. Plain text only (no HTML).
_schema.eggs[].sound: optional. A synthesized taunt to play with it: whisper | lowLaugh | mockCreak.
